budgets.name: perf.P12_initial_js_gzip
budgets.title: Initial JS, pipeline route
note: Measured from the client module graph, then cross-checked against a real
browser on both Playwright profiles: 105.6 KB gzip over 10 files, identical
to the byte. The graph computation is what runs here — it needs no browser,
no database and no session, and /board redirects when signed out.
Headroom is ~18% over the measurement, deliberately not zero. This budget
exists to catch a REGRESSION — the shape of it being the 147 KB gzip
better-auth 'identity' chunk reaching a seller-facing route — not to fail
the build the next time a screen gains a component.

budgets.name: perf.P13_initial_css_gzip
budgets.title: Initial CSS, pipeline route
note: 2.3 KB today for the whole design system, so the headroom looks large in
relative terms and is not. Three of the thirteen modules have any UI at all;
the token layers and the screens still to come land here.

budgets.name: perf.P6_drag_frames
budgets.title: Drag at 60 fps, 500-card board
note: 04b 3.2 P6: rAF deltas during a scripted 1200 ms three-column drag on a
500-card board. Fails on p95 > 20 ms, OR any frame > 34 ms, OR any long
task > 50 ms. Three separate failures, not one — a smooth average with a
single 60 ms stall is a drag that visibly jumps.
Enforced by tests/e2e/drag-perf.spec.ts, not by check-perf-budgets.ts:
this one needs a browser and a seeded board. The numbers live here so
there is one place they can be read from and one place they can be
loosened from.
The profile is dnd-ci — desktop-ci with a 2x CPU slowdown (04b 3.1), so a
green build means headroom on a seller's five-year-old laptop rather than
60 fps on a CI runner with nothing else to do.

budgets.name: perf.P20_mobile_tti_pipeline
budgets.title: Mobile time-to-interactive, /pipeline
blocked_on: The nightly Lighthouse tier does not exist, and neither does the perf-500
fixture (500 cards) this must be measured against. Gate 12 needs the same
fixture, so the two are cheaper together than apart.
Per 05-architecture.md 8.1 the measured value rounded up to the next 100 ms
becomes the budget, with 3000 ms as a ceiling that measurement cannot
exceed. This row is therefore a DECLARED HOLE, visible and machine-readable,
rather than a number nobody measured.
